about: The shared commands of the application and the events of triggers. A shared command does nothing by itself: plugins handle it in contributes.handlers, and the window runs the handler whose when holds, or offers the handlers as items where several do. A trigger in contributes.triggers runs its plugin's own handler on an event. `items` says where the items of a command come from: none, the handlers, the text versions of the file (the core), or the handler itself.

commands.title: Create text
commands.about: makes the text of a file, such as the text layer of a PDF or the transcript of a recording

commands.title: Delete text
commands.about: deletes a text version of a file

commands.title: Download media
commands.about: downloads the media of a link note

commands.title: Delete media
commands.about: deletes the downloaded media of a link note

commands.title: Get media
commands.about: returns the address a player plays the downloaded media of a link note from

events.name: file.added
events.about: a file that is not a note was added to the vault

events.name: note.added
events.about: a note was added to the vault
